title: Jury selection begins in hate crimes trial for Buffalo supermarket gunman
summary_full: Trial could see white supremacist who killed 10 people in New York state store get the death penaltyJury selection is set to begin on Tuesday in the trial that could see the white supremacist who killed 10 people in a 2022 Buffalo supermarket get the death penalty.The attack is believed to be the deadliest shooting targeting Black people in modern history.
